analysis.no_pruning_gap: Our no-pruning scores are systematically ~15-17 absolute points below published (72.06% vs 87.60% avg). This is consistent across all splits, suggesting a systematic difference in evaluation setup rather than a bug.
analysis.fastv_relative_match: FastV average (33.85%) is close to published (34.50%), within 0.65 points. This is the closest match to published numbers.
analysis.d2pruner_relative_benefit: D2Pruner (55.03%) shows 21.18 points improvement over FastV (33.85%), confirming debiasing provides significant benefit. However, absolute numbers are below published.
analysis.relative_ordering_preserved: The relative ordering is perfectly preserved: No-pruning (72.06%) > D2Pruner (55.03%) > FastV (33.85%)
analysis.d2pruner_relative_to_nopruning: D2Pruner retains 76.4% of no-pruning performance (55.03/72.06), vs published 85.68%
analysis.likely_cause_of_gap: The systematic gap in no-pruning scores suggests differences in image preprocessing, prompt format, or evaluation protocol. The model's grounding capability is genuine (median IoU ~0.87 for no-pruning) but many predictions fall just below the 0.5 IoU threshold.
